newsitem.title: USA: NGSA to intervene in U.S. utilities' NOx rule case.
newsitem.headline: NGSA to intervene in U.S. utilities' NOx rule case.

text.p: The Natural Gas Supply Association said Friday it will intervene in a case filed by a group of electricity utilities over a federal nitrogen oxide (NOx) control program.

The utilities last month challenged an Environmental Protection Agency rule issued December 19 that said natural gas reburn is a predominant technology for controlling NOx emissions from coal-using cyclone and wet-bottom-wall-fired boilers.
The utilities filed a motion in District Court for a rehearing on the rule, saying it had technical and procedural errors.
The NGSA said it will file as an intervenor because the natural gas industry could lose a potential 400-500 billion cubic feet of increased annual gas demand if the gas reburn provision were blocked.
